process

How it works

How it works

Every proposal passes deterministic checks. Your authority stays intact.

intent

04

Review, approve & execute

Proposal >

Ask the agent to prepare an action. It drafts a typed intent with an asset, route, amount and expiry; it never receives your keys.

Preflight >

The registry and issuer preflight check whether the asset and route are supported. Unknown or ineligible actions stop here.

Policy >

The policy vault checks your private limits. The risk engine checks route, price, quote freshness and slippage.

Approval >

Review the exact action. The smart account executes only with the required owner authorization and returns a receipt.

Private by default

Private by default

Your keys stay yours

01 / self-custody
